description: This file defines the EntityViewBuilderInterface interface for Drupal's entity view building system, including method signatures for rendering entities and managing cache.

methods.name: buildComponents
methods.description: Builds component fields and properties for a set of entities.

methods.name: view
methods.description: Builds the render array for a single entity.

methods.name: viewMultiple
methods.description: Builds the render array for multiple entities.

methods.name: resetCache
methods.description: Resets the entity render cache for specified entities.

methods.name: viewField
methods.description: Builds a renderable array for a field's value.

methods.name: viewFieldItem
methods.description: Builds a renderable array for a single field item.

methods.name: getCacheTags
methods.description: Returns cache tags associated with the entity view builder.
